page.overview:
Who is Alena?

Alena is a character from Dragon Quest IV: Chapters of the Chosen and a playable character in Itadaki Street DS. She is the Tsarevna (princess) of Zamoksva and is also known as a superb martial artist. Alena has been depicted to being a "tomboy" in terms of her personality. After Alena's first appearance alongside the Mario franchise characters, she makes a reappearance in Fortune Street.

In Itadaki Street DS, Alena is one of 11 playable Dragon Quest characters.

Alena's Hat and Alena's Clothing are collectible items that can be equipped on customizable characters.

Alena makes a returning appearance in the sequel to Itadaki Street DS, Fortune Street for the Wii. She appears visually unchanged, with her design being just slightly touched up since her appearance in Itadaki Street DS.
